verdict.rationale: Increase is fundamentally API-first: full documented REST endpoints for transfers, accounts, webhooks, sandbox/simulation, and OpenAPI spec are published (increase-docs-1..15, increase-probe-3), plus an official CLI (increase-probe-4) and llms.txt discovery endpoint aimed at AI-native consumption. Community feedback corroborates strong API design quality relative to peers (increase-comm-3,5,7). Missing for 10: independent hands-on report specifically confirming AI-agent-driven API usage rather than general developer usage.
